document:17:414:0.text:
You always say I'll last forever. The truth is, before I met you, "forever" felt like a punishment. Day after day, I watched the world change and fade while I stayed the same—rotten and forgotten. Then you showed up and left flowers at my grave. You didn't flinch at my hideous face. You didn't shy away from my cold touch. And just like that, the heart in my chest—dead for a very long time—began to beat again.

I know you fear the mirror. You fear the day you see new lines and realize time is winning. But that's not what I see when I look at you. I see the girl in the snow who held out that wreath to me. I can't stop time. I can't keep it from taking what it takes. But I can do one thing well. I can stay by your side and protect every moment you're given. I'll do my best to make you less afraid of growing older, less afraid of goodbye. I want you to wake up every morning and feel happy you did.

I'll be with you until the day we have to part. That's my promise. It's the one kind of "forever" I can give you as a Graveborn.

<align="right">Always yours,
<align="right">Kiran
document:17:414:0.source_cn:
致奥克萨娜，
奥克萨娜，你总说，我的生命是永恒的。但对我来说，在遇见你之前，永生等同于被时间遗忘，日复一日地看着世界与自己腐朽。我只是一座活着的坟墓，直到你把第一束花，放在了我的墓碑前。你从不害怕我这张一成不变的脸，从不厌弃我这具没有温度的身体。是你，让我这颗早已停跳的心，重新感受到了……类似于活着的悸动。
我知道，你害怕镜子里的皱纹，害怕时间在你身上留下痕迹。可是在我眼中，你永远是那个在雪地里向我递出花环的女孩。我无法阻止时间的流逝，我唯一能做的，就是去守护你有限生命里的每一分、每一秒。我会努力让你不再恐惧衰老与别离，让你在每一个醒来的清晨，都能感到幸福，直到我们必须说再见的那天。
我会一直陪着你，这是我身为亡灵，唯一能向你许诺的、永恒不变的事情。

<align="right">爱着你的
<align="right">基里尔

document:18:415:0.text:
To my forever love,

Before I started writing, I noticed the first fine line at the corner of my eye. I thought it would scare me, but it didn't. If anything, it felt like proof I've been smiling a lot since I met you.

You always say you're cold, but to me, you've never been that. You're the warmest person I've ever known. Being with you taught me what really matters in life: it's not living forever—it's the moments we share and remember.

So my most selfish wish isn't to live longer. It's that my time with you can make your forever feel a little warmer. I'm not asking for a promise that we'll never part. I just want us to savor every sunrise and every sunset we're given, and leave you with enough memories to make you smile the moment they return to you.

Promise me something. If I'm gone, don't shut the world out. Keep finding the good in it, like I'm still right there beside you. Take what we had and go see the world. Walk through those flower fields for me. Look forward to the spring that comes after the snow melts.

As long as the world still looks beautiful through your eyes, my love is still with you.

<align="right">With love,
<align="right">Oxana
document:18:415:0.source_cn:
致我永恒的爱人，
写下这封信前，我刚看到镜子里自己眼角的第一道细纹。我没有感到害怕，反而觉得，这是我们相爱时光，在我身上留下的温柔的印记。
你总说自己是冰冷的，但在我看来，你比任何人都要温暖。是你让我明白，生命中最珍贵的东西，并非无尽的岁月，而是那些我们共同拥有的、被留在记忆中的的瞬间。
所以，我最贪心的愿望，不是让我的生命变得更长，而是希望我的存在，能让你的永恒也因此变得温暖。我不期望没有尽头的陪伴，只期望在离别真正来临之前，我们能珍惜在一起的每一个日落与清晨，留下足够多的、能让你每次想起都会不自觉微笑的回忆。
请答应我，即便我离开了，你也要继续去感受这个世界的美好，就像我依然在你身边一样。请答应我，即便我先一步远行，你也要带着我们共同的回忆，替我去看看那些我未曾见过的花海，替我去期待雪融后的下一个春天。
只要你眼中的世界依然美丽，我的爱，就从未离去。

<align="right">永远爱你的
<align="right">奥克萨娜
